plain_summary_en: This paper studies Guilt becomes thinkable: Interactional history of therapy after ambiguous loss. In plain terms, it asks what is happening, why it matters for public communication, and what evidence the authors use. The likely focus is Guilt, Becomes, Thinkable, Interactional. The abstract suggests a mixed methods approach, which makes the work useful for understanding how communication changes in everyday life.
